packageRules.description: A family of packages released together moves in a pull request of its own, so an update that fails the gate holds back only its own family

effect 4.0.3 bounds every exported integer schema at the safe integers, which changes the OpenAPI document and the MCP tool listings, so effect comes in a pull request of its own that holds no other update back
Node.js moves in one pull request wherever the repository names it, so CI tests on the version the image runs

typescript6 is TypeScript 6 under an alias, the last version with the compiler API the program check of the definitions package calls, so it stays below 7; an alias is matched by its dependency name, since its package name is typescript
dumbo's 0.13.0-betabeta.50 is a mistyped tag published as latest, which semver ranks above every 0.13.0-beta.N; dumbo and emmett never take a version whose prerelease tag holds betabeta

google-auth-library makes the client the Vertex provider signs its requests with, so it stays on the major @ai-sdk/google-vertex depends on, which is 10; a client of 11 is not one the provider accepts

customManagers.description: Container images the workflows run in their steps, pinned by tag and digest
